name: css.gg
summary: Icon library of 700+ icons drawn in pure CSS and SVG, plus 6000+ glyphs, patterns, colors and layouts.
description: A CSS-first icon library: icons are drawn in pure CSS, with SVG and Figma UI icon versions available. The project also ships npm packages, an API/JSON feed and a Raycast extension, and newer versions add a browsable collection of 6000+ glyphs, patterns, colors and layouts. Licensed MIT up to v2.1.2, after which a custom agreement applies (attribution required, no derivatives, commercial use needs permission).
